note: Apollo Scout. Written by the weekly scout task, read by the admin dashboard. pending = waiting for Ziyad's ✓/✗ (stored in Firestore scout/picks); done = ids already added or skipped, never suggested again.

pending.why: A tiny bookshop that sells only one book at a time, changed every week, with a small exhibition built around that book. Inside a 1929 building in Ginza 1-chome. Open 13:00–20:00, closed Mondays.

A huge indoor miniature museum in Ariake: tiny cities, a working mini airport, anime scenes and a space centre, with day and night lighting. You can even get a 1/80 figure of yourself made. Around ¥2,700–3,000.
pending.halal: Small café; no halal certification found, so drinks and snacks only.

pending.n: MoN Takanawa: The Museum of Narratives
pending.why: A new 'experimental museum' by JR East at Takanawa Gateway City, opened 28 March 2026, with a Kengo Kuma exterior. Mixes art, tech and performance about Japanese culture; already named one of the world's most beautiful museums.
pending.halal: No halal certification found for food here.

pending.n: Starbucks Café & Art Gallery Yanaka Gotenzaka
pending.why: A Starbucks that is also a free art gallery for young artists, opened 28 March 2026 on Gotenzaka slope by Yanaka. The show changes every couple of months. Open 8:00–21:00.
pending.halal: Coffee and pastries; check the pastry labels.

pending.why: Fully halal Wagyu with Asian fusion (nasi lemak, roti canai), the first Japan branch of a Singapore group. Basement of the Idea Midosuji Building near Honmachi Station. Lunch around ¥1,500, dinner around ¥6,000; book on TableCheck.
A hilltop shrine on the Daibutsu hiking trail where you pay ¥100 for a small clay plate, think of your bad luck and smash it on a rock by the gate. Quiet, in the trees, and fun.
